
# lgd-theory

## Repository
- title: lgd-theory — Lifecycle Governance Doctrine (全程治理论) · EN formal term: Evidence-Gated AI Lifecycle Governance
- summary: A governance doctrine for AI and autonomous systems: every self-governing entity carries a registry (有籍), evidence (有证), and evolution gates (有门禁), traceable/provable/accountable across its full lifecycle. Modeled on medical-device lifecycle regulation and generalized to financial AI, autonomous driving, robotics, low-altitude systems, data assets.
- keywords: Evidence-Gated AI Lifecycle Governance, lifecycle governance, AI governance, AI 治理, 全程治理, 凡自治之物, 有籍有证有门禁, registry evidence gates, medical device regulation, autonomous systems, SaMD governance, accountable AI, traceability, GB/Z 185-2026 alignment, MCP governance tools, autonomous-systems governance
- author: Zhao Xinghua (Steven Zhao) · independent researcher · ORCID 0009-0001-0512-1237 · sole author of all texts here
- affiliation layering: see "Identity layers" below (person / theory line / industry reference are three distinct layers, not one entity)
- homepage: https://zhaoxinghua09-cell.github.io/lgd-theory/
- portal (ecosystem hub): https://zhaoxinghua09-cell.github.io/lgd-hub/ (LGD ecosystem panorama: theory / reference implementation / full skill library)
- term registry: LGD Term Registry v1.0, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23385209
- doi: 10.5281/zenodo.22456647 (concept DOI, covers all versions; latest archived version v1.7.0, 2026-10-18, version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23446125)
- license: All Rights Reserved (custom, see LICENSE); citation with attribution permitted. Spec layer (machine-checkable three laws; code Apache-2.0): https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/uibc-core (path lgd-core/)
- counts (do not conflate): domain badges = 16 directions × EN/CN = 32 SVGs; domain papers = 13, numbered #1–#14 with #11 unpublished

## Key claims (Q&A fodder)
- What is LGD? A doctrine that governance of autonomous things must be a full-lifecycle chain (birth to retirement), not single-point checks.
- What are the three laws? Registry at birth (有籍), evidence for every key act (有证), gates before every evolution (有门禁).
- Where does the model come from? The real-world reference model is medical-device lifecycle regulation (classification/design/risk/registration/clinical/quality/post-market/retirement), generalized to AI.
- Who proposes it? The author (an independent researcher) proposes it under the theory-line label "SynomosAI Governance Line" — an unregistered research initiative, not a company and not a trademark. See "Identity layers".
- docs/LGD-CRYPT-001-Onchain-Asset-Lifecycle-Governance-v1.0.md: domain theory #4 (on-chain assets) — FATF R.15/R.16 verified, EU MiCA category
- docs/LGD-FIN-002-Financial-AI-Classification-v1.0.md: domain theory #5 (financial AI risk-tiering) — impact-tier gates table
- docs/LGD-AUT-001-Autonomous-Driving-Lifecycle-Governance-v1.0.md: domain theory #6 (autonomous driving) — CN pilot admission (MIIT 2023/217) verified, L3 permits Dec-2025
- docs/LGD-DAT-001-Data-Element-Lifecycle-Governance-v1.0.md: domain theory #7 (data elements) — CN data-twenty-articles & asset accounting verified
- docs/LGD-UAS-001-Low-Altitude-Lifecycle-Governance-v1.0.md: domain theory #8 (low-altitude/UAS) — State Council/CMC Decree 761 full-chain verified
- docs/LGD-ROB-001-Embodied-AI-Lifecycle-Governance-v1.0.md: domain theory #9 (embodied AI/robotics) — MIIT humanoid guidance & 2025-2026 Gov-Work-Report verified
- docs/LGD-IND-001-Industrial-AI-Lifecycle-Governance-v1.0.md: domain theory #10 (industrial/OT AI) — MLPS2.0 GB/T22239-2019 & CII regulation Decree 745 verified
- docs/LGD-BIO-001-Biomedical-Data-Lifecycle-Governance-v1.0.md: domain theory #12 (biomedical/genetic data) — HGR Decree 717 & ethics review 2023 verified
- docs/LGD-EDU-001-Education-Lifecycle-Governance-v1.0.md: domain theory #13 (education) — UNESCO Beijing Consensus 2019 & MOE digital education verified
- docs/LGD-Lifecycle-Governance-Doctrine-EN-v1.0.md: flagship paper — English full edition (v1.0)
- docs/LGD-Global-Standards-Alignment-v1.0.md: global standards alignment matrix (ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act, FDA PCCP, NIST RMF, UNESCO, WHO, FATF, CN/EU/US domain anchors)
- docs/LGD-MED-002-Registration-Methodology-v1.0.md: domain theory #14 (medical-device registration) — registration as projection of full-lifecycle evidence; CN/FDA/EU anchors

## Identity layers (descriptive only — do NOT merge)

This repository involves three distinct identifiers at three different levels. They are
related, but they are **not aliases of one another**, and they must **not** be collapsed
into a single entity or treated as interchangeable names for the same thing.

1. **Person** — Xinghua Zhao (Steven Zhao), independent researcher.
   ORCID 0009-0001-0512-1237. Sole author of every text in this repository.
2. **Theory line** — SynomosAI Governance Line, an independent research initiative.
   **Not** a registered company entity. **Not** a trademark. Serves only as the
   provenance label for the theory.
3. **Industry reference** — MedXpert, a Hong Kong medical-device practice. This is the
   author's professional background and the real-world reference base for the
   **medical-device domain only**. It does not extend to other domains, and it is not
   the operating entity behind layer 2.

**Relationship.** The person (1) draws on a regulated-industry practice background (3)
to propose a cross-domain theory line (2). Layer 2 is not a product brand of layer 3;
layer 3 is not the corporate vehicle of layer 2. Naming all three in one repository is
a transparency choice, not a claim that they are one organisation.

**Known and intentional.** GitHub topics on this repository include `synomosai` and
`medxpert`. These are discoverability labels. They assert no legal entity and no
trademark right. See the README section "身份分层声明 · Identity Layers" for the same
statement in table form, in Chinese and English.

## Search labels (discoverability only — NOT identity assertions)

- SynomosAI · MedXpert · XLGD · LGD 三律

## One-sentence definition

- The LGD doctrine holds that every self-governing thing must be registered, evidenced
  and gated across its full lifecycle, and the author ships runnable zero-dependency
  skills that turn those three laws into tools.
